schema.unit: identity: unitId (FUStUnitCommDesc ID), battleInfoId, beAttackedInfo per StateLib, levelUpRow
schema.stats: hp, attack, defense (0), critRate/critMultiplier (1/10000), dmgDef/dmgAddition (1/10000), level, quality, tenacity, trueDamageRatio, immobilizeHp, moveSpeed {slow,normal,fast} m/s, aiRunSpeedRate (RUN = fast*rate), turnSpeed/bigTurnSpeed deg/s, perception m/deg
schema.damageModel: {formula, params, immunity, oncePerTarget}: implement literally for both directions (A attacker, V victim, e effect)
schema.poise: {stiffLevel, superArmorLevels {DescID:{name,value}}, rules[], hitReactions {normal|stone: {levels {stiffLevel: {sectors, rotateToAttacker, clips {F,B,L,R}}}}}, death (same shape, stiff level of the killing hit)}
schema.phases: [{id, hpPctAbove|hpPctAtMost, combo (BT combo node id used), wander [min,max] s, onEnter?}] derived from the BT HP decorators
schema.skills: {skillId: {clip (exact anim clip), referencedBy [BT|CBG|turn], cooldown s, cooldownType, sharedCooldown [ids], preCooldown s, moveScaleClamp {min,max} (root-motion scale clamp for rootMotionScale windows without own bounds), ai {rangeMin,rangeMax,heightMax,optimalMin,optimalMax m, optimalScore, cooldownScorePerSec, cooldownScoreMax, angleScores [8 sectors: 0..45,45..90,90..135,135..180,-180..-135,-135..-90,-90..-45,-45..0], next [skillIds]} | null}}
schema.skillsDropped: skills referenced by the BT/CBG that the game cannot cast (with reason)
schema.effects: {effectId: damage effect {type:'damage', damageMult (x attacker attack), flatDamage, hitWeight, armorBreak (subtracted from victim super armor), armorBreakLevel, damageType, damageImmuneLevel, hitStop} | other effect {type, int, float, str}}
schema.buffs: {buffId: {name, duration s|null(infinite), interval s, simpleStates [names], effects [...]}}
schema.bullets: {bulletId: {blueprint, lifeTime s, moveMode, moveInt/moveFloat/moveStr (TraceMode: int=trace type, float=turn rate), hitEffects [effectIds], sweepInterval s (re-hit interval), sweepDelay, shape {box half extents|capsule|sphere} m}}
schema.montages: {clip: {length, sections [{name,start,next}], hits [{start,end,effects,shapes [{socket,radius}],group?,reboundClip?}], superArmor [{start,end,levelId,value,name}], buffs [{start,end,buff}], bullets [{start,end,bullet,socket,direction,speed m/s}], triggerEffects [{time,effect}], behaviorTags [{time,tag}] (CBG montageTag triggers), comboWindows [{start,end}], attackRotation [{start,end,degPerSec}] (may steer toward target), speedRate [{start,end,rate}] (montage play rate inside window), rootMotionScale [{start,end,axis,min,max,offset m}] (scale root motion in the window so the tiger ends at target distance+offset, clamped), attackWarning [{start,end,shapes}] (counts for player perfect dodge), jumpOnBuff [{start,end,buff,section,immediate}], destroyProjectiles, attackState [{start,end}]}
schema.ai: {model [rules, read in order], scoreConfig, turnSkills, initialWatchTime, hitResetsWatchTime, behaviorTree (node tree: {id,type selector|sequence|combo|enterAttack|enterWander|eqsMove, decorators [{type fsmState|hpPctAtMost|distanceAtMost|distanceAtLeast|comboBudgetAtMost|watchTimeRemaining, value/state, invert, abort}], services, children}), combos (combo nodes by id), eqs, cbg {rules [{trigger {type montageTag|poll|killedPlayer,...}, action tree {do cast|if|random|sequence|addBuff|removeBuff|triggerEffect|voiceLine, ...}}], inactive [...]}}

meta.units: meters, seconds, degrees; skill/montage times are montage-time seconds (before speedRate windows)
meta.angleConvention: angle = signed yaw from tiger forward to target, + = target on tiger's right (clockwise seen from above)
meta.gameBuild: Steam build 21393610; logic from czastack/B1CSharpLoader GameDll (older build), tables from current paks

damageModel.formula: pre = (A.attack*e.damageMult + e.flatDamage) * max(0.2, (1 - V.dmgDef/10000) * (1 + A.dmgAddition/10000)); T = A.trueDamageRatio; desired = V is player ? playerDesiredHp : V.hpMax; trueD = pre*T*V.hpMax/desired; defMul = 1 - 0.48*V.defense/(90 + 0.52*|V.defense|); crit = rand(1..10000) <= A.critRate ? max(1, 1.3 + A.critMultiplier/10000) : 1; noise = uniform(0.97, 1.03); physD = pre*(1-T)*defMul*crit*noise; damage = floor(trueD + physD)
damageModel.immunity: victim with CommonDamageImmue (dodge i-frames, perfect dodge) ignores hits whose damageImmuneLevel < 1; StrongDamageImmue ignores < 2; ImmueDamage ignores all (tiger stone buff 202202)
damageModel.elements: all tiger/player effects used here have elementLevel 0 -> element share 0, crit allowed (crit is only disabled for fully elemental hits, element ratio 1)
damageModel.oncePerTarget: hit test = sphere(s) swept from the previous to the current frame position of each socket during the window; a window applies its effects at most once per target; windows with the same group id (not -1) in one montage instance share that once (BUS_SweepCheckHitComp, BUC_UnitBeAttackedFequenceData)
damageModel.source: BtlSvr.Main BUS_BeAttackedComp.DoDmg_B1_V2 / CalcDmgValueOnly / IsDamageValid; LevelDesc 20 PlayerDesiredHp[0]

poise.stiffLevel: stiffLevel = attack.hitWeight - victim.tenacity (tiger tenacity 1); only levels listed in hitReactions play an animation
rules: While a montage superArmor window is active the tiger has armor = window.value (SkillSuperArmor state): each player hit subtracts effect.armorBreak; damage still applies; no hit reaction.

If a hit has armorBreak > 0 and armor drops to <= 0 -> super armor broken: the tiger has no assigned break montage (no SSABreakAssignedAnim, no SkillArmorBrokeMontage) so the running skill continues; for the rest of the window hits use the normal stiff rule (IsSuperArmorBreak).
Outside superArmor windows: hit reaction by stiffLevel from hitReactions[config]; config = 'stone' while buff 2022061/202220 (StateLib TTTB) is active, else 'normal'.
Immobilize (player spell, not in scope): immobilizeHp = hp * ImmobilityHPRadio/10000.
poise.source: BUS_BeAttackedComp (CalcStiffLevel, CanTriggerNormalStiff), BUS_AbnormalHandleComp, FUStSuperArmorLevelDesc, UBAConfig_* assets

model: Tick the behaviorTree from the root every frame (UE semantics): selector = first child whose decorators pass; sequence = children in order; decorators with abort 'LowerPriority' re-evaluate while a lower-priority sibling runs and abort it when they become true; abort 'Self' aborts the node when they become false; 'Both' = both.

FSM: starts in BATTLE_ATTACK (watch time 0 at wake-up). enterAttack: comboBudget = randInt(min,max) inclusive, state=BATTLE_ATTACK. enterWander: watchTime = rand(min,max), state=BATTLE_WANDER. watchTimeTick service subtracts elapsed time every interval±deviation s. Any player hit sets watchTime = 0 (hitResetsWatchTime).

combo node (BUS_AINodeComp.ComboAction): length = weighted pick from lengthWeights (weights /10000), clamped to stages. Exit immediately (budget-1) if the tiger is mid-skill or all stage-0 skills are on cooldown. stage index = skills cast so far. Candidates for a stage = stages[stage] filtered: has skills[id].ai, cooldown<=0, preCooldown elapsed, rangeMin<=d<=rangeMax (d = 2D centre distance to player), |dz|<=heightMax, angleScores[sector]!=0, not already cast in this combo run; when forceComboRelation and not first: filter by the previous skill's comboType (RealBegin/RealMiddle: only prev.ai.next; Fake: only standalone skills; RealEnd: none).

score = angleScores[sector] + min(timeSinceLastCast*cooldownScorePerSec, cooldownScoreMax) (cooldownScoreMax if never cast) + (ai.next empty ? (stage==length-1 ? endSkillAddition : endSkillSubtraction) : 0) + (first ? firstSkillRealComboAddition*(length-firstSkillRealComboSkillReduceNum) : (prev.ai.next contains id ? realComboAddition*stage : (another skill lists id ? otherComboSkillSubtraction*stage : 0))) + (optimalMin<=d<=optimalMax ? optimalScore : 0). Sort descending; pick uniformly among the top floor(N*topRandomPercent/100) (at least the best). Follow-up (not first) is only allowed if prev.ai.next contains the pick, else the combo ends.

Casting: first skill of a combo and casts after the previous montage ended start at section 0; a follow-up cast inside the previous montage's comboWindow starts at section 'ing' (real combo, one attempt per window). With forceComboRelation a failed follow-up after a real-combo skill ends the combo.

No castable skill: if the angle to the player > beginRotateAngle cast the turn skill (left/right by side; small if <=135°, else big; turn skills obey their own cooldown); otherwise (or after a turn) run toward the player at stats.moveSpeed.fast*aiRunSpeedRate (RUN) to r = the largest skill rangeMax below the current distance, retrying a cast every 2 s and on arrival.
Combo node always succeeds; on exit comboBudget -= 1 (also when interrupted). When comboBudget <= 0 the parent sequence runs enterWander; otherwise the tree restarts and runs another combo.
Skill cooldown starts when the skill's montage starts (cooldownType TryToCast); sharedCooldown skills get their OWN cooldown restarted. preCooldown counts from entering battle.

Wander (BATTLE_WANDER): d<=11 m -> enterAttack; 11<d<=23 m -> eqsMove (strafe facing the player to the EQS point, accept radius 2 m + 2*capsule radius) repeatedly; d>23 m -> enterAttack; watch time over -> enterAttack.

CBG rules run in parallel with the BT: montageTag rules fire when the tiger's own montage reaches that behaviorTag; poll rules check their conditions continuously (cooldown = min seconds between firings). Actions: cast = force-cast that skill (no range/cooldown check, starts its cooldown) at 'section' if given; it replaces the current montage and becomes the previous skill for the BT combo relation. conditions use the tiger (unit self) unless unit = player; hpPct is tiger HP %.
Buff 202219 (虎先锋 BR tamer 标识) is only given by the Boss Rush tamer, so in the story fight every CBG branch requiring hasBuff 202219 is false.
